content_sections.heading: Govt ITI Anandapur Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Govt ITI Anandapur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Govt ITI Anandapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Instructor posts at Government Industrial Training Institute Anandapur is scheduled for 13 August 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced for the Guest Instructor post?
faq.answer: The Government Industrial Training Institute Anandapur has announced a total of 4 vacancies for the Guest Instructor position across various trades.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Guest Instructor posts?
faq.answer: The required qualifications vary by trade and include B.Voc/Degree, Diploma, and ITI (NTC/NAC) certificates with relevant experience as specified for each post.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the Govt ITI Anandapur Guest Instructor recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Guest Instructor role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test, Viva, and a Demo Class covering both Theory and Practical aspects of the trade.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Government Industrial Training Institute Anandapur, Odisha, PIN 758020.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any minimum or maximum age limits for these Guest Instructor positions. It is advisable to check the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q9. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Guest Instructor positions are contractual in nature, offering a temporary engagement with the Government Industrial Training Institute Anandapur.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. There is no online application process; candidates must attend the interview directly with their documents.
